newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish Akademiska Hus launches credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Swedish Akademiska Hus launches credit facility.

text.p: Swedish bank Swedbank said on Wednesday Swedish state-owned real estate group Statliga Akademiska Hus AB had mandated it to arrange a 1.35 billion crown seven year multicurrency revolving credit facility.
This is Akademiska Hus's first international loan transaction, Swedbank said in a statement.
"The facility has been structured as a club deal involving German savings bank related institutions," Swedbank said.
"The banks have been targeted by Akademsiska Hus and Swedbank with the aim of introducing the borrower to an increasingly important sector of the European banking community."
